cds.title: University of Idaho Common Data Set (latest posted: fall 2023 / 2023-2024) (PDF)

ipeds.title: IPEDS Admissions survey, fall 2024 entering class (ADM2024), as published in the Urban Institute Education Data Portal

stats.notes: The latest Common Data Set U of I posts is for fall 2023 (2023-24), so these figures are two classes old. Newer IPEDS (fall 2024 entering class): 13,443 applied, 10,154 admitted (75.5%), 2,025 enrolled. The international row (2,208 applied, 753 admitted, 116 enrolled) counts all international applicants, so it likely includes many who were admitted but never completed or did not qualify; U of I says its minimum GPA for international first-year applicants is 2.5. Undergraduate counts are the CDS B1/B2 'Total Undergraduates' (9,269, of whom 399 are nonresident) as of fall 2023; U of I's newsroom reports fall 2025 undergraduate headcount of 7,978. Student-faculty ratio is fall 2023 (17 to 1). No early decision or early action.

cds_test_policy.notes: The CDS (fall 2023 edition) says SAT/ACT are used and rates test scores very important; U of I's current first-year page says scores are not required with a 3.00+ GPA.

cost.notes: CDS H6 (2022-23 aid year): 1,734 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid (avg $12,390); the figure covers all nonresident undergraduates, not only international students. The CDS tuition fields could not be read as text, so costs come from U of I's financial aid office pages.
